summary: Iteration 49 verified all remaining backlog items: SALES-11/12 (voucher guest gating + user_id spoof protection), SALES-18 (allowed_transitions on GET/PUT status/PUT shipment), shipment audit_logs {from:{courier,tn}, to:{...}}, SALES-20 (dashboard + CRM segments via Mongo aggregation, paid_revenue delta on paid order), daily-backup cron (401/202, background creates system-cron backup, retention <=14), courier URL constants (jne, jnt, lainnya fallback), and a11y aria-labels on contact/newsletter/login/register inputs. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_iter49_features.py 14/14 passed. Regression: test_sales_flow.py + test_email_notify_e15.py = 23 passed / 1 skipped (pre-existing COD). Combined 37 passed / 1 skipped. Frontend: admin login + dashboard + CRM segments API + a11y attributes all confirmed on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (parfum-ecommerce-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Dashboard renders (28 orders, all cancelled from test seed cleanup — no live pending order to walk through admin-order-status-select UI; the SALES-18 allowed_transitions matrix was fully exercised via pytest on freshly created order across pending→paid→packed→shipped→completed).
critical_code_review_comments: services/vouchers.evaluate_voucher: SALES-11 correctly blocks guest when per_user_limit>0 with reason 'Masuk ke akun untuk memakai voucher ini' BEFORE checking redemptions — matches spec, avoids DB probe for anonymous.

routers/vouchers.validate_voucher: SALES-12 hardening confirmed — user_id derived solely from session; payload.user_id is documented as ignored and empirically unused (guest with spoofed user_id still returns 'Masuk ke akun...').

routers/admin_orders._with_allowed: correctly excludes 'paid' from allowed_transitions for non-COD unless payment_status=='lunas' (defends BUG-SALES-03). Returned on GET, PUT/status, PUT/shipment — consistent.
routers/admin_orders.update_shipment: audit meta now includes both {from,to} with courier+tracking_number — good traceability (addresses the iteration_48 review comment).

services/admin_stats: MongoDB aggregation via $group with $toLong safe-cast — no in-memory scan of all orders. paid_revenue = Σ(paid_amount - refunded_amount) across ALL statuses (including cancelled with partial refund), which is the correct 'net collected' metric.
services/backup_auto: KEEP_AUTO=14 enforced via find({created_by:'system-cron'}).sort(-created_at).skip(14) + delete — manual backups untouched. Verified count <=14 after cron trigger.
routers/cron._authorized: uses hmac.compare_digest (constant-time) — good against timing attacks.
services/audit.log_action uses field name 'entity_id' (not 'target_id') — anyone querying audit_logs must use entity_id.
